title: Quadrant rotation over time — portfolio centroids

axes.fm_x: weighted-mean corp-action-immune net active flow (₹cr/month); >0 = net bought
axes.weight: holding market_value, renormalised to the placeable equity sleeve

meta.centroid: holding-weighted mean of each equity name's ARM (y) and net active flow (x); the portfolio's centre of mass in the quadrant
meta.own_pctile: percentile rank (0-100) of the LATEST centroid within the entity's OWN monthly history; 50 = a typical month for this entity, 100 = its most constructive/aggressive ever. Null if < 3 months.

quadrant_labels.3: Not recommending + Bought (FM ahead of street)

meta.note: Centroids are AGGREGATES (weighted means over many names) — no per-stock ARM is shipped here. ARM is forward-filled from its last change-point on/before each month-end. A month is dropped if < 30% of the equity sleeve (by weight) can be placed on BOTH axes.
